title: 第5章 逆天自愈能力第6章 开挂的快乐
content_zh:
这就是一泡尿引发的灭门惨案。
张家人早上确定张大儿子长出武骨，拥有神奇的自愈能力后，便准备带上干粮，直接去县城找铁腿门。
结果张三嫌干粮不好吃，提议吃顿好的，庆祝庆祝，吃点喝点再走。
实际上，是张三想趁着这点时间，临阵磨枪，和自己这胆小的侄子亲近亲近，吹捧吹捧。
张三侄子心态还没调整过来。
见往日‘横行霸道’的叔叔这般捧着自己，在张三的诱导下，也许诺以后给家人各种好处。
你夸我，我捧你。
一来二去，两人都飘了。
穷人乍富，有个特点，就是下意识会去对比身边过的最好的人。
他们身边过的最好的人，自然就是李家了。
张三是因为自己原因，一向被李家人看不起，以前还被李家人打过，一直记恨着。
他侄子则是因为早就看上了李青山的妹妹，但胆子小，家里条件也不行，没敢表露过。
现在才有勇气和自己叔叔说上两句。
张三便拍着胸脯，表示在这石头村，好侄儿你以后看上哪个女人，那家就会跪着将人送过来，不然就折腾死他们。
自己侄子，可是生了武骨！
不就是李家的一个女人嘛。
他们以后站在李家人头上拉屎，李家人也不敢反抗，只会跪着过来舔他们。
张三见识浅薄，却没想过，死掉的武骨，啥也不是。
两人吃完饭，喝完酒，勾肩搭背，去路边撒尿，正巧李青山的弟弟妹妹路过。
李青山妹妹毕竟是女孩子，见着这一幕，就红了脸，想要快点走过去，却被张三拦住，口花花让她以后给自己侄子当暖床丫鬟。

这才有了后面的冲突...
...
可以说。
如果张家人一大早就往县城赶，又或是吃饭的时候少喝点酒水，又又或是，两人直接在家里尿桶里尿，都不会有后面的事情发生。
知晓了前因后果，李家众人，只觉这次不是张家祖坟冒了青烟，而是他们不知道在哪的李家祖坟冒了青烟。
幸亏今天发生冲突了。
不然按照张三的性格，让他们成功去了县城，得了势，李家真会被张三折腾得家破人亡。
也幸亏张三侄子只是拥有强大的自愈能力，本身也是个软蛋。
张家人不跑，是挨了一番毒打，想跑身体都不支持。
对方却连毒烟都能无视。
如果对方胆子大一点，挨了一番毒打后，就独自朝县城跑去，他们也没辙。
这么一看，他们老李家祖坟确实冒了青烟。
李铁也忍不住感慨道：“难怪爷爷从小就强调李家的家风，要是家里出了一个张三这样的人，被坑死了都不知道怎么死的...他侄子也是个废物，就算没遭今天这劫，养成了这性子，有武骨帮助，怕也成不了事。”
一旁的李青山想了想，跟着点点头。
老爷子确实很厉害。
李家老爷子当年逃荒而来，在铁腿门安排下，最后落地石头村。
周围都是刚刚安稳的流民。
这时候，就要藏，与人无争，休养生息。
所以李铁他爹，还有几个生的早的伯伯，都被培养得勤恳良善，相对单纯。
等李家站稳脚跟，开枝散叶，教导的方向便又发生了变化。

这才有了李家众人现在的模样。
...
问完了话，确定没有隐患。
张家人也就没有存在的必要了。
李家年长些的，熟络地拿上工具，开始在选好的地方挖坑。
content_en:
This is a tragedy caused by a leak of urine.
After the Zhang family confirmed in the morning that their eldest son had grown martial bones and had miraculous self-healing abilities, they prepared to bring dry food and go directly to the county town to find the Iron Leg Gate.
As a result, Zhang San thought that the dry food was not delicious, so he proposed to have a good meal to celebrate, eat and drink before leaving.
In fact, Zhang San wanted to take advantage of this little time to sharpen his skills in battle, get close to his timid nephew, and flatter him.
Nephew Zhang San has not yet adjusted his mentality.
Seeing that his 'tyrannical' uncle in the past held him up like this, under Zhang San's inducement, he promised various benefits to his family in the future.
You praise me and I praise you.
After going back and forth, both of them drifted away.
One characteristic of poor people suddenly becoming rich is that they subconsciously compare themselves to the best people around them.
The best people around them are naturally the Li family.
Zhang San has always been looked down upon by the Li family because of his own reasons. He was also beaten by the Li family before, and he has always held a grudge.
His nephew had fallen in love with Li Qingshan's sister for a long time, but he was timid and had poor family conditions, so he didn't dare to reveal it.
Now I have the courage to talk to my uncle.
Zhang San then patted his chest and said that in this Stone Village, good nephew, whichever woman you like in the future, that family will send her over on their knees, otherwise they will be tortured to death.
My nephew has a martial bone!
Isn't she just a woman from the Li family?
In the future, they would stand on top of the Li family to shit, and the Li family would not dare to resist, they would just kneel over and lick them.
Zhang San has little knowledge, but he has never thought that the dead martial bones are nothing.
After the two of them finished eating and drinking, they hooked up and went to the roadside to urinate. Li Qingshan's younger brother and sister happened to be passing by.
Li Qingshan's sister is a girl after all. Seeing this scene, she blushed and wanted to walk over quickly, but was stopped by Zhang San, who told her to be his nephew's bed-warming maid in the future.
This is where the subsequent conflict begins...
...
It can be said.
If the Zhang family had rushed to the county town early in the morning, or if they had drank less alcohol during meals, or if the two of them had peed directly in the bucket at home, nothing would have happened later.
Knowing the cause and effect, everyone in the Li family felt that this time it was not the Zhang family's ancestral tomb that was smoking, but the Li family's ancestral tomb that they didn't know where.
Fortunately there was a conflict today.
Otherwise, according to Zhang San's character, if they successfully go to the county seat and gain power, the Li family will really be ruined by Zhang San.
Fortunately, nephew Zhang San only has strong self-healing ability and is also a softie.
The Zhang family did not run away, but they were beaten so hard that their bodies did not support them even if they wanted to run away.
But the other party can even ignore the poisonous smoke.
If the other party was bolder and ran towards the county seat alone after being beaten, there was nothing they could do.
Looking at it this way, there is indeed smoke coming out of the ancestral grave of the old Li family.
Li Tie couldn't help but sigh with emotion: "No wonder grandpa has emphasized the family tradition of the Li family since he was a child. If there was a person like Zhang San in the family, he would be tricked to death and he would not know how to die... His nephew is also a waste. Even if he did not suffer the disaster today, he has developed this temperament and has the help of martial arts. I'm afraid he won't be able to do anything."
Li Qingshan on the side thought for a while and nodded.
The old man is indeed very powerful.
The old man of the Li family fled from famine and finally landed in Stone Village under the arrangement of Iron Leg Gate.
Surrounded by refugees who have just settled down.
At this time, it is necessary to hide, have no fight with others, and recuperate.
Therefore, Li Tie's father and several uncles who were born early were all raised to be diligent, kind and relatively simple.
When the Li family established a firm foothold and spread its branches, the direction of teaching changed again.
This is how everyone in the Li family looks now.
...
After asking, I made sure there were no hidden dangers.
There is no need for the Zhang family to exist.
The elder of the Li family took the tools familiarly and started digging a hole in the chosen place.
